notes.title: v1.2 Cursor + Graphical Updates
notes.content:
[b]Mirrored cursor + minor visual adjustments[/b]
The default mouse cursor becomes hidden at the beginning of each level and is replaced by glowing cursors that mirrors the mouse position on both panels. 

Tip: Press "H" if you want to revert back to the normal mouse icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36996328/e7f8a6e30f57262c2c08e833ccdb111e906e4426.png[/img]

[b]Further visual adjustments in addition to v1.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Repositioned crosswalk
[*] Resized run and jump dust
[/list]

notes.title: Graphical Update
notes.content:
I agree with the comments saying some of the puzzles were frustrating and unreasonably difficult to find, so I went back and updated them by replacing them with new puzzles or adjusted their graphics to improve their readability. Here is a sneak peek of some of the new puzzles and adjustments:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36996328/aa01e84fb9b2a434d47cebf7a1fff52a866ca688.png[/img]

Have a good one everyone!
